name: Endeavour (STS-113)
about: Endeavour (STS-113) (2002-052A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2002 Nov 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2002 Nov 26), held fixed
docked to A06140; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q1135865), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory

events.why: landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
